```{=html}
<style>
.w076-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w076-dd .w076-zones {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w076-dd .w076-zone {
  padding: 8px; border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); text-align: center; cursor: pointer;
}
.w076-dd .w076-zone .w076-desc { font-size: 0.8rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.75; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w076-dd .w076-zone .w076-slot { min-height: 34px; display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center; }
.w076-dd .w076-zone.w076-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w076-dd .w076-zone.w076-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w076-dd .w076-zone.w076-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w076-dd .w076-pool {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; justify-content: center;
  min-height: 44px; padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w076-dd .w076-chip {
  padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
  border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.w076-dd .w076-chip.w076-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w076-dd .w076-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w076-dd button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w076-dd .w076-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w076-dd .w076-expl { font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32; padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px; }
.w076-dd .w076-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w076-dd .w076-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w076-dd .w076-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w076-dd iw" id="w076-dd">
  <div class="w076-zones">
    <div class="w076-zone" data-answer="protection domain">
      <div class="w076-desc">a set of (object, rights) pairs:<br>for one actor, which operations on which objects</div>
      <div class="w076-slot"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w076-zone" data-answer="access control matrix">
      <div class="w076-desc">every domain a row, every object a column -<br>the most general statement of who may do what to what</div>
      <div class="w076-slot"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w076-zone" data-answer="uid and gid">
      <div class="w076-desc">received at login and inherited by every process -<br>the pair that defines a Linux process’s domain</div>
      <div class="w076-slot"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="w076-zone" data-answer="system call">
      <div class="w076-desc">a switch to a more privileged domain:<br>the user half traps into the kernel half</div>
      <div class="w076-slot"></div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="w076-pool" aria-label="terms to place"></div>
  <div class="w076-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w076-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w076-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w076-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w076-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w076-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w076-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    A protection domain is a set of (object, rights) pairs for one actor, and with every domain as a row and every object as a column the result is the access control matrix, the most general statement of who may do what to what. On UNIX and Linux a process&rsquo;s domain is defined by its UID and GID, received at login and inherited by every process, and a system call is a switch to the more privileged kernel domain; role, entitlement and set-UID are related course terms, but they do not fit these four descriptions &mdash; see <a href="#sec-07-protection-domains">the section on protection domains and the access control matrix</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w076-dd');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w076-pool');
  const zones = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w076-zone')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w076-msg');
  const expl = root.querySelector('.w076-expl');
  const TERMS = ['Access control matrix', 'Entitlement', 'System call', 'Protection domain',
                 'Role', 'UID and GID', 'set-UID'];
  let picked = null;

  function makeChip(term) {
    const c = document.createElement('span');
    c.className = 'w076-chip';
    c.textContent = term;
    c.dataset.term = term.toLowerCase();
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement !== pool) { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); return; }
      if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
      unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w076-picked');
      zones.forEach(z => z.classList.add('w076-armed'));
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', term));
    return c;
  }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w076-picked');
    picked = null;
    zones.forEach(z => z.classList.remove('w076-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    zones.forEach(z => z.classList.remove('w076-right', 'w076-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w076-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(zone, chip) {
    const slot = zone.querySelector('.w076-slot');
    const old = slot.querySelector('.w076-chip');
    if (old) pool.appendChild(old);
    slot.appendChild(chip);
    clearMarks();
  }
  zones.forEach(zone => {
    zone.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(zone, picked); unpick(); } });
    zone.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    zone.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const term = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w076-chip[data-term="' + term.toLowerCase() + '"]');
      if (chip) { place(zone, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const term = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    const chip = root.querySelector('.w076-chip[data-term="' + term.toLowerCase() + '"]');
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); unpick(); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w076-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0, empty = 0;
    zones.forEach(z => {
      z.classList.remove('w076-right', 'w076-wrong');
      const chip = z.querySelector('.w076-chip');
      if (!chip) { empty++; return; }
      if (chip.dataset.term === z.dataset.answer) { z.classList.add('w076-right'); right++; }
      else { z.classList.add('w076-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    if (right === zones.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - the matrix behind every authorisation scheme.'; msg.className = 'w076-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (empty > 0 && wrong === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Keep going - ' + empty + ' box(es) still empty (three of the seven terms are distractors).'; msg.className = 'w076-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - the red boxes are wrong (three of the seven terms are distractors).'; msg.className = 'w076-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  function resetAll() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w076-chip').forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
    expl.hidden = true;
  }
  root.querySelector('.w076-reset').addEventListener('click', resetAll);
  root.querySelector('.w076-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    resetAll();
    zones.forEach(z => {
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w076-chip[data-term="' + z.dataset.answer + '"]');
      if (chip) z.querySelector('.w076-slot').appendChild(chip);
      z.classList.add('w076-right');
    });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w076-msg iw-msg ok';
    expl.hidden = false;
  });
  TERMS.forEach(t => pool.appendChild(makeChip(t)));
})();
</script>
```
